status: review trial; existing installed faces preserved

code.generics: Tall < by default; short between whitespace on both sides or lowercase/digit/underscore operands. Adjacent words containing uppercase letters retain tall generics (bounded32glyph context). Greater-than policy unchanged.
code.generic_height: Halfway between comparison-sign and bracket height; centered within baseline/cap-height limits.

rust_lifetime.policy: ASCII apostrophe before identifier starts; quoted identifiers up to 32 letters/digits retain normal quote. Nearby-character heuristic does not parse source strings/comments.

numerals.oldstyle: Sans onum/lnum; lining figures remain default

dots.master: Code uses its existing variable period; Sans and System use their existing variable i dot.
dots.clearance: Minimum 12 units or 8% of dot width for horizontal pairs; preserve ldot/Ldot stem clearance and a 12-unit gap between Code question/exclamation and division dots and bodies.
